headline: Angus Leads Off Two 0-3 Teams And A Whole Lot Of Small Sample
intro: Two or three games in, win pace is still producing absolute lunacy, with teams sitting at 82 or 0 wins and every score swinging like a pub door. Angus (+144.0) leads Leon (+124.3) and Nic (+69.0), and the spoon is Sam at −126.0, though the efficiency column says half of this table is lying to us. Plenty of injuries to chew on too, with Joel Embiid and a bunch of Warriors on the sidelines, so let's get stuck in.

players.name: Angus
players.text: Top of the pile at +144.0, built on Warriors and Pelicans unders sitting at 0-3 and Raptors and Lakers overs both unbeaten. But the efficiency number is a far more modest +63.3, so don't book the trophy engraver yet, Gooey. The Warriors Under is the cleanest part of it: Jimmy Butler out until January, Porzingis and Moody out until December, and Curry, Draymond and Horford all added to the injury list this week.

players.name: Leon
players.text: Mr Overs is second at +124.3 and his efficiency score of +92.5 is the best in the comp, so this one's no fluke. Pistons, Rockets, Blazers and Grizzlies overs are all unbeaten, and Optimism Has Merit again. The only blemishes are the Nets Over at −24.5 and the Jazz Over at −10.2, and the Pistons losing Duren for at least two weeks is the one thing that should make him nervous.

players.name: Nic
players.text: Visdog sits third at +69.0, mostly on the back of Knicks, Bucks and Kings unders all losing every game they've played. The Blazers Under is costing him −39.5 with a 2-0 start, and the Celtics Over is a quiet −10.5 at 1-1. His efficiency total of −0.7 says this is more luck than skill so far, but a lead is a lead, so enjoy it while the Blazers are winning in Leon's favour.

players.name: Marco
players.text: Marci is fourth at +20.7, with the Wolves Over doing the heavy lifting at +33.5 after a 2-0 start. Early days, but the efficiency number of −24.7 suggests his portfolio is flattering him a bit. Donte DiVincenzo's Achilles surgery (out until April) is a real worry for the Wolves Over, and it's a big win for Harry's Wolves Under.

players.name: Ned
players.text: Fifth at −12.0 for a bloke who wasn't even in the draft, which is a respectable effort for the fade merchant. The Magic Under (+43.5) is the star of the show, helped by Banchero being out until late November with an ankle sprain. The Rockets Under at 3-0 (−34.5) and Pistons Under at 2-0 (−32.5) are the anchors, and Duren's two-plus weeks out is the first bit of good news he's had on that front.

players.name: Roscoe the Dog
players.text: Roscoe is sixth at −37.3, and I say this with love, his picks are better than the scoreboard suggests with an efficiency number of +26.4, the best of the non-drafters. Warriors Over at 0-3 (−40.5) and Raptors Under at 2-0 (−35.5) are doing the damage, and Kawhi sitting out with knee swelling won't help the Raptors Under fans. That Heat Under at 0-3 (+46.5) is a ripper though, good boy.

players.name: Harry
players.text: Harry's at −43.0 and the Magic Over at 0-2 (−43.5) is the whole story, with Banchero out for around 12 games to make it worse. The Wolves Under is at −33.5 right now but DiVincenzo's season-ending Achilles gives him a lifeline. Clippers Over has Beal and Ingram out until early November and Jordan Miller until March, so it's not exactly a stress-free portfolio.

players.name: Dan
players.text: Doccy's −49.4 is a mixed bag of the 76ers Over at 3-0 (+31.5) and the Lakers Under at 3-0 (−35.5) cancelling each other out, plus a Spurs Over at 1-2 costing −32.2. That said, the Spurs finally got their first win against the Mavs, so there's a flicker of hope. LeBron returning for the Sixers is a boost for the Over, but Embiid sitting with plantar fasciitis management is the flip side, and Hukporti is gone for the season.

players.name: Pos
players.text: Pos is at −89.3, and the Grizzlies Under (−52.5 at 2-0) and Heat Over (−46.5 at 0-3) are two big reasons why. The Heat Over might be cooked early, and the Grizzlies have Edey, Stewart and Coward all on the injury list, which at least gives that Under some hope. The Spurs Under is the one saving grace at +32.2, but he needs a few more of those to climb out of the hole. Remember, in this comp a single −10 will kill ya, and he's got a few.

players.name: Sam
players.text: Sammy holds the spoon at −126.0, and the picks are going nowhere fast: Knicks Over at 0-2 (−52.5), 76ers Under at 3-0 (−31.5), Bucks Over at 0-3 (−25.5). His efficiency of −23.1 suggests it's not quite this dire, but Furphy out for the season is bad news for the Pacers Over. Start planning how you'll tell Roscoe you're coming to dinner, mate.

signoff: May your unders tank and your overs thrive!
